fullPassage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.

det.korean: 다원적 사회의 '수용'을 장려하는 → encourage + 명사(acceptance)
det.analysis: encourage __________ of a more pluralistic → encourage 뒤에 목적어(명사)가 와야 함. accept(동사) → acceptance(명사)로 변환. encourage acceptance = 수용을 장려하다.
det.tip: accept(받아들이다, 동사) → acceptance(수용, 명사). encourage + 명사

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a __________ means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시트콤의 유머가 다원적 사회 수용을 장려하는 '비용 대비 효과적인' 수단으로 작용했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① time-consuming — 시간이 많이 드는 (부정적 뉘앙스, 장려 수단에 부적합)
✅ ② cost-effective — 비용 대비 효과적인. a cost-effective means ←정답
❌ ③ short-lived — 오래가지 않는 (부정적 뉘앙스)
❌ ④ old-fashioned — 구식의 (시트콤의 역할과 무관)
det.tip: cost-effective = 비용 대비 효과적인. 복합형용사 하이픈 형태.

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as __________. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시민권, 여성 인권, 아동 인권, 이민과 다문화주의뿐 아니라 '변화하는 가족 개념'도 다루었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① traditional images of the media — 미디어의 전통적 이미지 (본문에 없는 표현)
❌ ② rejection of different opinions — 다른 의견의 거부 (본문 취지와 반대)
✅ ③ evolving conceptions of the family — 변화하는 가족 개념 ←정답
❌ ④ rigid expectations of the workplace — 직장의 경직된 기대 (본문에 없는 표현)
det.tip: evolving conceptions of the family = 변화하는 가족 개념. 나열된 사회적 이슈 중 마지막 항목.
